# Whispera Backend

> Voice-to-action backend service. Users speak; transcription happens on-device (Mac/iOS); this backend runs prompt recipes (multi-step LLM pipelines) against Claude and OpenAI, with per-request BYOK and a credits/Stripe fallback.

The full OpenAPI 3.1 specification is auto-generated from Zod schemas and served at `/docs/json` when the server is running. An interactive Swagger UI is at `/docs`.

## Architecture (one-paragraph summary)

Node 20 + TypeScript (ESM, strict). Fastify 5 with manual route registration in `src/server.ts`. PostgreSQL 16 via Drizzle ORM (postgres-js driver). Auth via Clerk JWT (`@clerk/backend`). LLM access via the Vercel AI SDK (`ai` + `@ai-sdk/openai` + `@ai-sdk/anthropic`) with `generateText` and `experimental_transcribe`. Per-request BYOK is implemented by calling `createOpenAI({ apiKey })` / `createAnthropic({ apiKey })` inside each handler. Pipelines are executed by a hand-rolled sequential `PipelineExecutor`.

## Endpoints (client-facing)

### Health
- `GET /health` — liveness, returns `{ status, timestamp, version }`.

### Auth (Clerk-backed)
- `GET /auth/me` — current user record. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <clerk JWT>`.

### BYOK key management
- `POST /auth/api-keys` — store an encrypted OpenAI/Anthropic key. Body: `{ provider, key, label? }`. Provider is `openai` | `anthropic` | `claude`.
- `GET /auth/api-keys` — list metadata (no plaintext) for the caller's stored keys.
- `DELETE /auth/api-keys/:id` — remove a stored key.

### Recipes (CRUD)
- `POST /recipes` — create a recipe. Body: `{ name, steps[], description?, triggerPhrase?, outputFormat?, isPublic? }`.
- `GET /recipes` — paginated list. Query: `page`, `limit`, `search`.
- `PUT /recipes/:id` — partial update.
- `DELETE /recipes/:id` — soft delete.

### Executions
- `POST /recipes/:id/execute` — run a recipe pipeline. Body: `{ input?, stream?, variables? }`.
  - When `stream: true`, the response is a Server-Sent Events stream emitting `step:start`, `step:complete`, and `execution:complete` events.
  - Otherwise, a JSON snapshot is returned.
- `GET /recipes/:id/executions` — list executions for a recipe (paginated).
- `GET /executions/:id` — fetch a single execution.

### Chat (direct LLM)
- `POST /chat/completions` — direct LLM chat. Body: `{ messages[], provider?, model?, stream? }`. Key resolution order: `X-Provider-Key` header (pass-through BYOK, never stored) → encrypted key from `/auth/api-keys` → OpenAI Codex OAuth → platform key + credits.
  - Default model: `gpt-4o` (OpenAI), `claude-sonnet-4-6-20250501` (Anthropic).

### Transcribe
- `POST /transcribe` — Whisper audio transcription. `multipart/form-data` with a file field and optional `language` text field. Returns `{ text, language, duration, provider }`. Backed by a pluggable `TranscriptionProvider` (`src/services/transcription/`); the default is `openai.transcription('whisper-1')` via the AI SDK, and `TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=custom` + `TRANSCRIPTION_BASE_URL` points the same OpenAI audio API at a self-hosted or proxied endpoint. See CLAUDE.md for the full env var table.

### Store, billing, OAuth (less commonly wired by clients)
- `/store/*` — public recipe store (browse, publish, install).
- `/billing/credits` — credit balance lookup; `/billing/webhooks/stripe` — Stripe webhook (server-to-server, signature-verified).
- `/auth/oauth/openai/*` — OpenAI Codex OAuth flow ("Sign in with ChatGPT") via PKCE.

## Authentication

All non-health endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. In production, the token is a Clerk-issued JWT verified via `@clerk/backend`. In test mode, the token is treated as a raw clerk-id string and the user is JIT-created. See `src/plugins/auth.ts`.

## BYOK headers

For `/chat/completions`, clients may send `X-Provider-Key: <sk-... | sk-ant-...>` to bypass any stored key. The backend forwards this directly to the provider and **never persists it**. See `src/plugins/provider-key.ts` and `src/routes/chat/completions.ts`.

## SSE streaming

Recipe execution with `stream: true` uses `reply.hijack()` and writes raw SSE frames. Each frame is `event: <name>\ndata: <json>\n\n`. The connection ends on `execution:complete` or on client disconnect.

## Reading the OpenAPI spec

```bash
# Live (server must be running)
curl http://localhost:3000/docs/json

# Interactive UI
open http://localhost:3000/docs
```

The OpenAPI document is regenerated on every server start from the route schemas defined inline in `src/routes/`. There is no separate hand-maintained spec.

## Optional

- The Mac/iOS Whispera client is in a separate repo and integrates with this backend over HTTPS.
- Provider keys for local development are intentionally not in this repo. Use `.env` with `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` for E2E tests.
